source: version and description from Postgres public."SDKVersion"; pushed_date from the package registry publish date, falling back to CHANGELOG.md, git tags, then manifest history

sdk_versions.description: Expanded attribution responses with ad-network campaign, ad set, and creative IDs and names for campaign-level reporting.
Breaking change: payment capture now requires a non-empty paymentId so every payment can be uniquely identified.
Added setCustomerUserId, which persists the application user ID and automatically includes it with subsequent tracked events.
Updated the Android SDK to encrypt SDK credentials at rest with AndroidKeyStore.
Added the handleDeeplink API for processing incoming deep links and resolving re-engagement attribution.
Aligned the native iOS SDK dependency with the Netcore-compatible release.
Added the Netcore device GUID to user data so Linkrunner users can be matched with Netcore profiles.
Implemented iOS push-token forwarding for uninstall tracking.
Internal package maintenance release; no public API or runtime behavior changes were documented.
Normalized iOS attribution response keys to JavaScript-style camelCase.
Added optional event data to payment capture for Meta Commerce Event Manager.
Added Google Analytics session ID collection so Linkrunner events can be correlated with analytics sessions.
Added Meta view-through attribution so eligible conversions can be attributed to ad impressions without a click.
Removed trailing Swift commas for compatibility with older Swift versions.
Updated LinkrunnerKit to support Apple Search Ads attribution.
Removed the deprecated JCenter repository from the Android build.
Added event IDs to trackEvent requests so individual custom events can be identified and deduplicated.
Added Braze device ID and Google Analytics app instance ID fields.
Added Android backup exclusions for Linkrunner SharedPreferences on Android 6 through 12 and later.
Updated the iOS bridge with SECOND_PAYMENT so follow-up payments are classified consistently across platforms.
Updated the Android bridge with SECOND_PAYMENT support.
Removed unused native dependencies and updated the Android SDK retry implementation.
Updated LinkrunnerKit to add SKAdNetwork attribution support.
Updated the Android SDK and removed the unused Koin dependency.
Added an iOS initialization option to disable IDFA collection when advertising identifiers are not required.
Updated native SDK dependencies and added a default value for the debug option.
Added the initialization debug option and corrected the user-data bridge structure.
Reworked native SDK integration and added attribution-source data to attribution responses.
Improved device-data collection with safe getters and error handling.
Fixed deeplink handling so a URL is stored only when available.
Added optional payment type and payment status fields so payment events can include lifecycle and outcome information.
Added Google Analytics attribution processing so campaign data can be included in Linkrunner attribution results.
Updated TypeScript output settings and added TSX compilation support.
Added direct links to function reference documentation.
Corrected and expanded documentation for the public React Native APIs introduced in version 1.0.0.
Added trackEvent, signup, setUserData, and triggerDeeplink and deprecated the legacy trigger API.
Read the SDK package version dynamically from package.json.
Added Expo development-build integration documentation.
Clarified the meaning and usage of the attribution metrics introduced in version 0.8.0.
Expanded attribution results with additional performance metrics and documented the new response fields.
Fixed iOS install-referrer availability checks to avoid calling APIs that are unavailable on the running OS version.
Expanded attribution results with campaign-level data for downstream reporting and routing.
Updated install instance ID documentation and examples.
Added install instance ID support for consistently identifying an application installation.
Added payment capture APIs for sending revenue and transaction details to Linkrunner.
Updated API examples and usage guidance to match the current React Native method signatures.
Expanded SDK method results with additional response data for use by JavaScript callers.
Removed the encrypted-storage dependency and simplified token handling.
Added the originating mobile platform to API requests so backend processing can distinguish Android and iOS traffic.
Corrected package documentation and release metadata so installation instructions and published package details stay consistent.
Updated token-link handling and corrected the user-data schema.
Added deep-link opening support so resolved destinations can be launched from the application.
Expanded installation, initialization, and usage guidance to make the first React Native integration easier to complete.
Added encrypted storage for SDK tokens to protect persisted credentials on the device.
Added the trigger API for starting Linkrunner attribution and deep-link processing from JavaScript.
Added the initialization API for configuring Linkrunner from React Native applications.
Initial React Native package release establishing the JavaScript API and native Android and iOS bridge structure.
